title: I built a mmWave material classification radar (2025)
summary: A maker built a custom millimeter-wave radar system capable of classifying different materials using signal processing and machine learning techniques, demonstrating an open-source approach to mmWave sensing technology.
problem_solved: Enabling material identification and classification using affordable DIY radar hardware instead of expensive commercial solutions.
why_valuable: Provides an accessible, open-source implementation of mmWave radar technology for researchers and hobbyists interested in material sensing applications.
